_meta.purpose: ENGINE FIXTURE — the spider test. Invented, corpus-free, belongs to the engine.
_meta.central_tension: Brave in general, and morbidly afraid of one specific thing. The whole point of the fixture is that no single trait word describes him: 'brave' is true and 'terrified' is true, and which one you see depends on what is in the room and who is standing behind him.
_meta.calibration: threat_reactivity low + temperament.FEAR.mean 0.22 => a genuinely steady man. The phobia lives ENTIRELY in baseline.catalog, not in the genotype, which is the point: a global gain cannot say 'brave except about spiders'.
_meta.scale: all 0..1 unless noted; catalog multipliers are ratios

fixed.name: Ren

position.place: no fixed place — a traveller who walks the upland circuit and winters wherever the work is
position.class: itinerant, unpropertied, and entirely unremarkable to anyone who matters; he is trusted on the road because he has never once failed to arrive
position.era: a settled century; the roads are safe enough that the danger left is weather, animals, and bad footing
position.niche: carries goods and word between upland villages, and is the man sent down the old workings when something needs fetching out of the dark

genotype._note: one {hit, hold} cell per path (2026-09-10). hit = how hard a reading lands; hold = how long they keep it. Where they REST moved to baseline.temperament[path].rest the same day — that is character design, not genotype. His old effortful_control 'high (he has talked himself down off worse)' has no cell yet; it is the HOLD on WARINESS and DISPLEASURE here.

WARINESS.hit: low (steady under danger; the road taught him early that panic is what kills you)

GOODWILL.hit: elevated (attaches hard to the few he travels with)

fixed.voice: level, unhurried, few words on the road and fewer underground
fixed.physical: forty, weather-cut, long-boned, hands ruined by rope

temperament._note: Where they REST, per path — a character-design choice beside the voice (owner, 2026-09-10). `rest` is the authored word (quiet|low|raised|high = rung 1..4, capped per path) or a number; `mean` is DERIVED from it once (heritable.ensure_temperament) and then moved only by the arc engine's durable diffs. lint_book warns when the mean's rung and the rest word's rung disagree.

WARINESS.rest: raised (watchful by habit — the road and the old workings; the HIT is what is steady)

model._note: weighting over the worth menu + resolution priority
resolution_priority: get the other one out first > finish the job
admit the thing you cannot do > let someone rely on you for it

catalog._note: TIER 3 — the buff/debuff registry (docs/decision-engine.md §effective-state catalog). Each row is {when, lever, op, magnitude, source}. Rows apply on the STANDING FACT; appraise() fires on the CHANGE. Magnitudes are Class-A authored numbers, calibrated against the direction bands (0.25/0.55/0.80) so a fired row is VISIBLE rather than lost inside a band.

rows.source: he stops wanting to know what is further in
someone at his back he means to bring out — he steadies for them, not for himself
the one he is responsible for is inside the same danger
worn down; the talking-himself-down costs more than it used to

goals.goal: bring whoever is with him back up the way they came down
finish the fetch and be paid

orientation.coping: keep moving, keep talking, do not look up

voice.register: level and unhurried; shorter underground than above
tics: counts steps out loud when the footing is bad
will not say a thing is fine when it is not

wounds._note: ENGINE WOUNDS (gate three, 2026-09-11) — see maren-healer.json. The spider scar is a `predator` wound on WARINESS; the catalog row that used to double it is gone (a wound multiplies the receipt through connection.for_about, never the float).

wounds.text: a hunting spider's bite swelled his face shut and left him three days blind when he was a boy; he was alone in a barn loft and nobody came until it had run its course
trigger: something moving in the dark above

current._note: turn 0: partway down the old workings on the upland road.

active_goals.goal: get down, get the thing, get back up before the light goes

joss_apprentice.history: the apprentice; Ren said he would have him back by dark and Joss's mother heard him say it

loc.upland_road.note: life: he carries goods and word between the upland villages — the road is his living
